refusal_catalog.human_text: Input matrix is not human_serum. V1 is serum-only by contract.

refusal_catalog.trigger: analyte not in {n_pfoa, sb_pfoa, n_pfos, sm_pfos}
refusal_catalog.human_text: Analyte is not in the V1 PFOS/PFOA scope. V1 scores only n-PFOA, Sb-PFOA, n-PFOS, and Sm-PFOS.
Missing required unit declaration. V1 requires result_unit='ng/mL' on every row.
Unit is not ng/mL. V1 does not auto-convert; relabel and convert upstream, then resubmit.
Missing required source_program declaration. V1 expects source_program='CDC NHANES' (or a documented equivalent that the operator has reconciled against the cycle-J anchor).
Missing or non-numeric result_value. V1 needs a finite ng/mL concentration to compute percentile context.
The precomputed NHANES weighted reference table on disk does not match the documented SHA-256. V1 refuses to compute percentiles against a drifted reference.
The cycle-J governance anchor CSV on disk does not match the documented SHA-256. V1 refuses to proceed when the provenance chain is broken.

reproducibility.deterministic_replay: Given the same input CSV, the same ontology JSON, the same weighted reference table, and the same code version, V1 emits the same output_hash. The provenance logger records (input_hash, reference_table_hash, ontology_hash, code_version) and derives run_id deterministically from those four; the timestamp is metadata only. The cycle-J anchor CSV is verified for provenance chain integrity but is not queried at runtime.
reproducibility.ontology_change_signal: Editing any value in this JSON (including this very block) changes ontology_hash, which changes run_id, which changes output_hash. The replay test test_changed_ontology_changes_manifest enforces this invariant.
